newsitem.title: USA: SDL CFO to leave company. [CORRECTED 19:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: SDL CFO to leave company. [CORRECTED 19:00 GMT]

text.p: SDL Inc said Monday that Chief Financial Officer Gregory Lindholm (corrects title) is leaving the company, and Executive Vice President John Melton will succeed him on an interim basis.
The company also said Melton had taken on the management of its finance department effective immediately.
The company said Lindholm is leaving SDL to pursue other interests in the San Diego area.
The company said it is beginning a formal search for a new CFO.
